title: Space under a fixed choice
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes, let $b$ be a choice bit, let $w$ be a finite choice word, and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input. Suppose that, at every time $j<|w|$, whenever the run of the machine that always uses choice $b$ from $c$ is in a state $q$, the two transition functions agree at $q$ for every possible scanned input and work-tape contents. Then the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited in the run from $c$ under $w$ equals the space used in the first $|w|$ steps of the machine that always uses choice $b$.
